name: AI & Machine Learning
description: How models learn, fail, generalize, and shape the systems built around them.
foundation: Basic probability, linear algebra intuition, and how a model is trained.

name: AI Engineering & Infrastructure
description: Serving, evaluating, and operating machine learning systems under real constraints.
foundation: How model inference works, plus basic APIs and latency.

name: AI-Assisted Software Development
description: Working with coding agents without giving up judgment, safety, or understanding.
foundation: Comfort reading, testing, and reviewing code in at least one language.

name: Algorithms & Data Structures
description: The ideas behind efficient computation, from probability to graph structure.
foundation: Big-O notation and basic data structures.

name: Computer Architecture
description: What the machine actually does beneath your source code.
foundation: How source code becomes instructions, and what a memory hierarchy is.

name: Operating Systems
description: The invisible machinery that shares hardware between unruly programs.
foundation: Processes, threads, and basic system calls.

name: Networking
description: How packets find their way, and why the path is never as simple as it looks.
foundation: IP addresses, ports, and the client-server model.

name: Distributed Systems
description: Coordination, failure, and consistency across machines that cannot agree on time.
foundation: Networking basics, and why remote calls can fail.

name: Databases & Storage Engines
description: How systems store, find, and protect data when the dataset outgrows memory.
foundation: Relational tables, SQL basics, and transactions.

name: Software Architecture
description: Design decisions that determine how software evolves, scales, and resists change.
foundation: Experience building and changing a non-trivial codebase.

name: Programming Language Design
description: The type systems, memory models, and runtime choices that shape how we think in code.
foundation: Experience with at least two languages and basic type concepts.

name: Compilers & Runtimes
description: How source code becomes machine behavior, and where optimization changes meaning.
foundation: Parsing basics, and how high-level code maps to instructions.

name: Cybersecurity
description: Attack surfaces, defensive design, and the assumptions that quietly fail.
foundation: HTTP, authentication, and how web applications are deployed.

name: Cryptography & Applied Security
description: The math and protocol design behind trust on an untrusted network.
foundation: Modular arithmetic intuition and basic hashing.

name: Cloud Computing
description: The primitives, abstractions, and failure modes of rented infrastructure.
foundation: Virtual machines, containers, and basic networking.

name: DevOps & Platform Engineering
description: Turning build, deploy, and operations into a reliable internal product.
foundation: Version control, automated tests, and deployment basics.

name: Site Reliability Engineering
description: Engineering for reliability budgets instead of hoping nothing breaks.
foundation: Service metrics, logging, and how incidents are handled.

name: Backend Engineering
description: The request path, queues, caches, and state machines behind the API.
foundation: HTTP, databases, and server-side programming.

name: Frontend Engineering
description: Rendering, state, and performance in the most hostile runtime you ship to.
foundation: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and the browser.

name: API Design & Integration
description: Contracts between teams and systems, and the cost of changing them.
foundation: HTTP methods, JSON, and authentication basics.

name: Data Engineering
description: Moving and reshaping data without losing correctness, freshness, or trust.
foundation: SQL, file formats, and batch versus continuous data.

name: Information Retrieval & Search
description: Ranking meaning: indexes, relevance, embeddings, and the limits of similarity.
foundation: Basic probability and text processing.

name: Computer Science Theory
description: Complexity, computability, and the boundaries that do not move.
foundation: Proof techniques and basic discrete mathematics.

name: Performance Engineering
description: Measuring first, then finding the constraint that actually limits the system.
foundation: Big-O notation, plus a profiler or timing measurements.

name: Testing & Verification
description: Evidence that software does what it should, not merely that it runs.
foundation: Writing and running automated tests.

name: Open-Source Engineering
description: Maintaining public software: governance, compatibility, and invisible labor.
foundation: Git, code review, and package distribution.

name: Developer Tools & Build Systems
description: The compilers, linters, and build graphs powering the inner loop.
foundation: Command-line builds, dependency managers, and editors.

name: System Design
description: Choosing boundaries, data flows, and failure strategies before writing code.
foundation: Backend basics and the idea of horizontal scaling.

name: Privacy & Digital Trust
description: Collecting less, exposing less, and proving what happens to user data.
foundation: How web data is collected and stored.

name: Technical Product Thinking
description: Connecting engineering choices to user problems and business reality.
foundation: Building a feature and observing how people use it.

name: Robotics & Embedded Systems
description: Software that must obey physics, power budgets, and real-time deadlines.
foundation: C or C++ basics, and what a microcontroller does.

name: Computer Vision
description: Turning pixels into structure, and understanding where perception fails.
foundation: Linear algebra and basic neural networks.

name: Natural Language Processing
description: Language, meaning, evaluation, and the strange behavior of text models.
foundation: Basic machine learning and text processing.

name: Reinforcement Learning
description: Learning from consequences: reward design, exploration, and fragile policies.
foundation: Probability and basic optimization.

name: Datacenter & Infrastructure Engineering
description: The physical systems behind the cloud: power, cooling, networks, and scarcity.
foundation: Servers, networking, and physical infrastructure basics.

name: Software Supply-Chain Security
description: Trusting dependencies, builds, and the people behind your software.
foundation: Package managers, dependency files, and continuous integration.

name: Engineering Economics & Trade-Offs
description: Why the technically superior option can still be the wrong engineering decision.
foundation: Basic cost awareness and how engineering time is allocated.

name: Human–Computer Interaction
description: Designing interfaces around human attention, memory, and error.
foundation: Designing or building an interface people actually use.

name: Emerging Computing Paradigms
description: New computing substrates and what they might change about software.
foundation: Comfort with basic physics or hardware abstractions.
